transportSelector.serverCrossCheck: The server must fail closed when the selected transport conflicts with the device class or trusted client context.

webH5.request: Refresh credential is sent only by the HttpOnly-Secure-SameSite cookie.
webH5.response: Refresh credential is returned only by Set-Cookie and is absent from JSON data.

native.request: Refresh credential is an explicit JSON body field on the NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE variant.
native.response: Refresh credential is a required JSON data field on the NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE variant.
native.storage: Keychain-or-Keystore-only; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and any plaintext fallback are prohibited.

x-b8-compatibility.rule: Only iam-service may mint tokens. Compatibility routes are historical-only, cannot mint tokens, and fail closed.

tags.name: b8-auth
tags.description: Self-owned JWT authentication center and IAM policy boundary

post.summary: Create an adult Phase 1 account and establish a restricted JWT session
post.description: Unauthenticated public registration for people aged 18 or above. Only iam-service receives the password and issues the session; Phase 1 learning access remains denied until the server-derived adult Gate passes.

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: Return the original account/session result for the same request hash.

201.description: Account created and a transport-specific JWT session issued

post.summary: Verify account password and issue a JWT session

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: The same request key returns the same login session result without creating a second session; a different request key is independently rate-limited and audited.

200.description: Transport-specific JWT Access Token session issued

post.summary: Rotate the opaque Refresh Token and issue a new JWT

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: The same request key can safely retry the same rotation result; a previous Refresh Token presented with a different request key is a replay, so revoke its entire token family and return 401.

WEB_COOKIE.refreshCredentialInput: HttpOnly-Secure-SameSite cookie only; request JSON must not contain refreshToken
WEB_COOKIE.refreshCredentialOutput: Set-Cookie only; response JSON data must not contain refreshToken

200.description: Refresh rotation completed through the selected transport

post.summary: Revoke the current device session and clear its selected refresh credential transport

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: Repeated logout is safe and returns the same terminal result.

NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE.clientAction: native client removes the refresh credential from Keychain or Keystore

WEB_COOKIE.clearWhen: the revoked session is the current browser session

NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE.clearWhen: the revoked session is the current native session; delete only from Keychain or Keystore

x-session-revocation.target: server-owned session selected by sessionId and authenticated subject
x-session-revocation.tokenFamily: revoke the target session token family

get.summary: Publish IAM public JWT verification keys

x-audit-correlation.keyMaterial: never logged or returned beyond public JWK fields

200.description: Public IAM signing keys only; no private key material

post.summary: Create a rate-limited one-time password reset challenge

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: The same request key returns the same non-enumerating accepted result without issuing a second challenge.

accepted.description: Always true so the response cannot reveal whether an account exists.

post.summary: Consume a one-time password reset challenge

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: A reset challenge can be consumed once; repeats return 401.

onSuccess.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: client clears its Keychain or Keystore Refresh Token after all prior sessions and token families are revoked

get.summary: List the current principal device sessions

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: Same request hash returns the stored gate result.
Same version and decision is idempotent.

post.summary: Evaluate an authorization decision from server-derived context

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: Decision IDs are auditable and may be cached until cacheUntil.

B8ServiceIdentity.description: Internal service JWT; issuer, signature, algorithm, audience, time and token_type are independently validated.

B8AuthTransport.name: X-Auth-Transport
B8AuthTransport.description: Authentication credential transport selector. Omission is backward-compatible WEB_COOKIE. NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE must be explicit and is cross-checked by iam-service; it is never authorization evidence.

B8AuthTokensCreated.description: Legacy reusable registration response. The formal request operations use the same B8AuthTokenEnvelope transport discriminator.

x-auth-transport.WEB_COOKIE: Set-Cookie must be emitted and JSON data has no refreshToken
x-auth-transport.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: Set-Cookie must be absent and JSON data.refreshToken is required

B8AuthTokens.description: Legacy reusable login/refresh response. The formal request operations use the same B8AuthTokenEnvelope transport discriminator.

x-auth-transport.WEB_COOKIE: Set-Cookie must be emitted and JSON data has no refreshToken
x-auth-transport.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: Set-Cookie must be absent and JSON data.refreshToken is required

B8Jwks.description: Public IAM signing keys only; no private key material

B8NoContent.description: Password reset applied; prior sessions and Refresh Token families are revoked.

x-auth-transport.WEB_COOKIE: Set-Cookie clears the matching browser Refresh Token
x-auth-transport.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: Set-Cookie is absent and the client clears the Keychain or Keystore credential

B8Unauthorized.description: HTTP 401: account credentials or JWT issuer, signature, algorithm, audience, time window, token type, scope or session is invalid

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge without token or validation details.

B8Forbidden.description: HTTP 403: authenticated principal lacks the server-derived permission

B8AccountLocked.description: Account temporarily locked after failed attempts

B8RefreshCookie.description: WEB_COOKIE variant only: Set-Cookie must set yuxuexing_refresh=<opaque>; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=<positive seconds>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax. It is never emitted by the native variant and is not readable by Web/H5 JavaScript.

B8RefreshCookieClear.description: WEB_COOKIE variant only: Set-Cookie must clear yuxuexing_refresh with yuxuexing_refresh=; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=0; Expires=<past HTTP-date>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax. It is never emitted by the native variant.

B8AuthNoStore.description: Authentication material responses are never stored by shared or browser caches.

B8JwksCacheControl.description: Public JWKS caching is bounded so new and retired kid values converge safely.

B8ErrorEnvelope.description: Compatibility error shape for existing IAM operations. New or migrated operations use ApiErrorEnvelope.

message.description: Non-sensitive localizable message; never echo password, Refresh Token or key material.

password.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; optional native credential; Web sends HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

B8WebDeviceInput.description: WEB_COOKIE request device boundary for browser Web and mobile H5. The server derives authorization facts independently of this device declaration.

B8NativeDeviceInput.description: NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE request device boundary for iOS, Android and native iPad runtimes. The server derives authorization facts independently of this device declaration.

password.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

B8WebRefreshRequest.description: WEB_COOKIE refresh input. The opaque Refresh Token is sent only by the HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite cookie; JSON must not contain refreshToken.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; explicit native refresh credential. Store only in Keychain or Keystore; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

resetToken.description: TLS only; one-time credential; 禁止日志或明文持久化。

newPassword.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

B8AuthTokenResponse.x-compatibility-role: Legacy broad token response retained so existing generated-client imports remain source-compatible. New authentication operations use B8AuthTokenEnvelope with an explicit transport discriminator.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

refreshToken.description: TLS only; native-only rotated opaque credential; Web receives an HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志。

authTransport.description: Optional legacy discriminator. New clients use the required discriminator on B8WebAuthTokenResponse or B8NativeAuthTokenResponse.

B8WebAuthTokenResponse.description: WEB_COOKIE authentication result. Refresh Token is intentionally absent from JSON and is returned only by the HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite Set-Cookie header.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT. Keep in memory only; never log or store in Web storage.

B8NativeAuthTokenResponse.description: NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE authentication result. The explicit Refresh Token is required and may only be written to Keychain or Keystore; all ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT. Keep in memory only; never log or store in ordinary storage.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; rotated opaque credential. Persist only in Keychain or Keystore; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

B8AuthTokenEnvelope.description: Canonical ApiSuccessEnvelope with an explicitly transport-discriminated authentication data payload.

deviceId.description: Optional public device id; server generates one when absent.

B8JwksResponse.x-jwks-boundary: Public RSA signing keys only; private key material is never exposed. RS256 is the only Phase 1 algorithm.

kid.description: Stable key identifier used to select the RSA/RS256 public key during the documented overlap window.
